Chat Completions API

POST
/chat/completions
modelstring

Possible values: [deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp]

thinkingobject
typestring

Possible values: [enabled, disabled]

reasoning_effortstring

Possible values: [high, max]

response_formatobject
typestring

Possible values: [text, json_object]

toolsobject[]
typestring

Possible values: [function]

streamboolean

If set, partial message deltas will be sent as data-only server-sent events.

stream_optionsobject
include_usageboolean

The last content chunk before the data: [DONE] message carries the token usage statistics for the entire request. Its choices array always contains exactly one element that carries no new content and a non-null finish_reason.

modelstring

The model used for the chat completion.

completion_tokensinteger
prompt_tokensinteger
